description: Paid: $1.00 USDC on Base over x402 inside MCP (the first call returns the payment requirements; @x402/mcp clients pay automatically). Buys 10 days of monitoring for one x402 endpoint: probed about every 15 minutes, with a signed alert whenever status, payability, price or payTo changes. Use when: your agent depends on one endpoint and must learn quickly if it changes. Not for: one-off checks (settled_check). Give url to start or watch_id to renew; give webhook to have alerts POSTed, else read them with settled_watch_alerts. Returns watch_id.

url.description: The x402 endpoint to watch, e.g. https://api.example.com/search; required unless watch_id is given

watch_id.description: The watch_id of an existing watch to renew for 10 more days; give this or url, not both

webhook.description: https URL that receives each alert as a signed POST; omit to poll with settled_watch_alerts

name: settled_watch

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements; pay one and call again with the payment in _meta

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

baseline.description: The endpoint's state when the watch started

error.description: Present only when the call failed or needs another step: an error code such as pass_required, next to the fields that explain it

renewed.description: true when this call renewed an existing watch

watch_id.description: The watch's id: keep it to read alerts and to renew

webhook_host.description: Host the alerts are POSTed to, if a webhook was given

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 version of the requirements

title: Buy a Watchdog for an x402 endpoint
